nodes.title: Import ngModel for numeric controls
nodes.why: FormsModule is the only external template dependency: it supplies ngModel and the number value accessor, while @if and @for are built into the template syntax.
nodes.alternative: Keep CommonModule for control flow that Angular now provides directly.
nodes.tradeoff: Minimal imports stay clear, but any later CommonModule pipe must be added explicitly.

nodes.title: Keep typed values apart from the rendered grid
nodes.why: [(ngModel)] writes every edit into rowInput and colInput, while rows and cols change only in updateTable(), so the table waits for the Generate button.
nodes.alternative: Compute rows and cols directly from the input signals.
nodes.tradeoff: A computed grid would redraw on every keystroke and make the button pointless; two extra signals keep the explicit generate step the task asks for.

nodes.title: Render a grid only for positive dimensions
nodes.why: The computed flag drives the template's @if, so zero rows or zero columns show the empty message instead of an empty table shell.
nodes.alternative: Always render table markup even when one dimension has no cells.
nodes.tradeoff: The conditional adds a separate empty state, but the visible result is easier to understand.

nodes.title: Clamp requested dimensions
nodes.why: Bounding rows and columns prevents negative or unreasonably large grids from reaching the DOM.
nodes.alternative: Trust any numeric input and allocate arrays directly from it.
nodes.tradeoff: The cap limits the demo to twenty rows or columns, but it protects preview responsiveness.

nodes.title: Track generated rows by stable numeric value
nodes.why: Each generated row value equals its index, so the values are unique and track row in the template keeps the existing rows when the grid grows or shrinks.
nodes.alternative: Build a new object per row and track it by reference, which recreates every row on each Generate.
nodes.tradeoff: Numeric identity is simple for this generated range, while richer row data would benefit from explicit ids.
